entries.subject: Measurements
entries.finding: EHT Collaboration (2019), ApJL 875, L1 (M87 Paper I, Table 1: angular gravitational radius, mass, distance); EHT Collaboration (2022), Sgr A* Paper VI (the Schwarzschild shadow diameter 6 sqrt(3) theta_g). The 2019 M87 papers state no shadow diameter measured from the data alone, so the disc is the shadow of the measured theta_g.

entries.subject: EHT image
entries.finding: The 2017 calibrated data (2019-D01-01) and the three imaging pipelines (2019-D01-02) are public; the eht-imaging pipeline carries its fiducial parameters, and no Top Set parameter table was released for M87, so the image is the one fiducial run. The 2018 M87 data (2024-D01-01) are public too, with the pipelines of EHT Collaboration (2024, A&A 681, A79); the 2017 April 11 image is the one M87 Paper I shows, so it is the one drawn.

entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: SIMBAD, CDS Strasbourg (position of M 87, reference 2020A&A...644A.159C, ICRF3).
